notes.title: Version 0.6.4
notes.content:
📢 Important Notice
This update includes changes to the save files, so it is recommended that you delete your previous game data.
[hr][/hr]🔄 Changes
The player will no longer spawn at a checkpoint. Instead, your last position will be saved, and when the game starts, the character will remain still. You will have to choose the direction in which you want it to start running (similar to when you get up after a fall).

User settings will now be saved even if you delete your game data.

The colliders of collectible objects have been enlarged.

Character movement has been tweaked in the NPC area.

The timing of when cloud colliders activate and deactivate has been adjusted.
[hr][/hr]🐞 Bug Fixes
Corrected spelling and grammar errors in both English and Spanish throughout the menu and tutorial sections.

The menu now closes properly when the camera is moving.

Fixed collider issues in the pipe area.

The character will no longer change direction when interacting with the Moai (this used to happen occasionally).

Fixed a bug where the character could sometimes pass through walls when trying to return to the Moai.

Fixed the backwards double-jump bug.

Fixed the bug where a backward jump played the normal jump animation.

Fixed the bug where the character could change direction mid-air after touching a ceiling during a backward jump.

Fixed a bug where only the background of the main menu would appear when returning to the main menu.

Fixed a crash caused by the dissolving tree material.

Fixed a crash caused by storage overload.
[hr][/hr]
If you encounter any bugs or the game crashes while playing, please report them in my Discord server: https://discord.gg/K3SxJAb4KX

notes.title: Update 0.6.2
notes.content:
Demo Update

Fixed rendering issues on screens other than 1920x1080

You can now restart a game from the menu

Fixed several collision and bounce bugs

Tutorial only appears during the first playthrough

New difficulty mode “Learning Mode” that doesn’t penalize you when the three days end

Time nerfed (time now passes more slowly — the 3-day cycle now lasts 47 minutes total)

VSync enabled

Grammar mistakes corrected

Mo’s dialogues in the main level no longer move with him, making them easier to read

The intro cutscene will only play when starting the game if no save file is found

New dialogues added when the world is reset

New bordered screen mode to allow gameplay recording with webcam space that doesn’t cover important game elements

When resetting the world, you are now sent directly to the main level instead of the menu

Slight changes to the tutorial

Charge will now reactivate automatically when you touch the ground again, if it was active before

New option in the controls menu: hold the charge button to activate and release to deactivate

You can now fast-forward through NPC dialogues

A visual signal has been added to show when the menu cannot be opened

Improved transition when entering the tree

Landing smoke effect now appears in the correct position

New screen brightness option

NPCs now wake up earlier
